notes: Owner: *"We need to make it feel to the user more like a spreadsheet model with some rows prefilled but editable and having the ability to add new rows and or customizations. right now it reads like editorial for each sector and industry."* Correct — the templates resolved into read-only prose cards, and the only edit path was MCP. The Sectors tab's dependency section is now a grid: prefilled template rows with the elasticity editable in place (a save appears on change), an + Add row with driver/source selectors built from served catalogs, and a delete per row — every change recorded as an OWN
